# Sygma Security & Electrical

> > Sygma provides BAFE-certified fire alarm systems, commercial security solutions (CCTV, intruder alarms, access control), and electrical services including solar panels and EV chargers across Essex, Kent, and the UK.

Sygma is a UK-based integrated security, fire safety, and electrical contractor serving commercial and domestic clients. They specialize in BS-compliant installations, remote monitoring services, and maintenance across Essex (Chelmsford, Colchester, Southend), Kent, and Nottinghamshire, with certifications including BAFE, NICEIC, and SIA licensing.

## Key Topics

- BAFE-certified fire alarm installation
- BS5839 fire safety compliance
- IP CCTV and remote monitoring
- Commercial intruder alarm systems
- RFID access control and key fob systems
- Remote Video Response Centre (RVRC) monitoring
- Solar panel and EV charger installation
- Essex service area (Chelmsford, Colchester, Basildon)
- SIA-licensed security operators
- NICEIC-approved electrical contractors
- BS8418 CCTV monitoring standards
- Wireless fire detection systems
- ANPR camera systems
- Commercial security compliance
- Fire alarm maintenance requirements
